# AMLO 2022 — Chapter 5B Document Map (BOOK-013 / CIDOB biography)

Coverage window in extract: mostly 2006-2018 transition/campaign narrative; not the 2018-2024 AMLO presidency itself. Any direct 2022 claim should be flagged as absent. Source role: independent_reference (CIDOB biography).

## Source-level notes
- Document type: biography (chronological narrative).
- Institutional role: CIDOB research centre, Barcelona; analysis of global and Mexican political dynamics.
- Coverage cap stated explicitly: "(Cobertura informativa hasta 6/8/2018)" — block 66. Everything after AMLO's 2018 election is not covered here.
- Mixing observed facts (dates, vote shares, statutes), author framing (e.g., "histórica", "tsunami", "colapso del PRI"), and subject-self-report ("no mentir, no robar…"). Mark self-report as **subject assertion / campaign speech**, not as evaluated outcome.

## Atomic claims with locators (5B-relevant)

### Track record & claims relevant to 5B.10, 5B.1, 5B.3
- **Block 46, 48** — 2012 campaign pledge: "tasa de crecimiento 'incluyente' del 6% anual" claimed as triple the prior 12-year PAN average; 1.2 million jobs/year; minimum wage above inflation; universal health and education coverage; pensions for adults 68+ and persons with disabilities. → **Campaign pledge; outcome not in extract.**
- **Block 62** — 2018 program "austeridad republicana": no new taxes (some cuts in US-border states), no new debt; minimum wage raised gradually to 171 pesos by end of sexenio; pensions 1,500 pesos/month; energy/food self-sufficiency via local guarantee prices. → **Program commitment; execution not documented here.**
- **Block 63** — Platform 2018-2024: pragmatic social democracy; accepts "principios ortodoxos del libre mercado, el libre comercio, la estabilidad macroeconómica, la disciplina presupuestaria, la flotación del peso y la autonomía del Banco de México"; rejects "neoliberalismo" and "tendencias privatizadoras". → **Author description of platform**, not outcome evaluation.

### Reform & appointment framing — 5B.2
- **Block 49** — Hypothetical 2012 cabinet: Cárdenas → Pemex; Ebrard → Gobernación; Poniatowska → Cultura. **Counter-factual/never materialised.**
- **Block 53** — MORENA officers Nov 2012: Martí Batres (CEN president), Bertha Luján (SG); later **Block 56** (Nov 2015) Polevnsky → SG; Luján → Consejo Nacional; AMLO → CEN president by "aclamación".
- **Block 66** — 2018 majorities: 308/500 deputies, 69/128 senators with PT+PES under "Juntos Haremos Historia".
- **Block 63** — AMLO campaign statement: "No voy a meter a Peña Nieto en la cárcel" → **campaign pledge/self-restraint**.

### Crises, sanctions, inflation — 5B.9
- **Block 58** — EPN-era inflation cited as political pressure on incumbents; fuel/electricity price rises despite 2013 energy reform promising lower prices. → **Author summary of pre-2018 conditions.**
- **Block 58-59** — Trump-era pressures on Mexico: wall, US tariffs on metals, NAFTA renegotiation; AMLO position: postpone NAFTA talks until after 2018 election vs. Peña Nieto's rush to close.

### Energy, infrastructure, sectoral — 5B.6
- **Block 40-41** — 2008 energy-reform fight; PRD lost; Comisión Nacional de Hidrocarburos created; package approved Oct 2008 with PRI/PAN/PVEM + "Los Chuchos" PRD votes.
- **Block 54** — EPN 2013 energy reform: ends Pemex/CFE monopoly regimes in practice; AMLO framed this as privatising "el legado del presidente Lázaro Cárdenas"; PRI counter-claim that state ownership of oil/gas was preserved. → **Contested claim from opposing camps.**
- **Block 64** — 2018 plan to scrap NAIM, instead develop Santa Lucía (AISL) on existing military facilities; cited "exorbitantes sobrecostes" and environmental impact of NAIM as justifications. → **Author rationale for a still-unexecuted policy.**

### Anti-corruption & rule of law — 5B.5, 5B.7
- **Block 46** — 2012 platform: "limpiar al Gobierno como a las escaleras"; anti-corruption bodies; truth commissions for FOBAPROA and Pemex; "no persecución contra nadie".
- **Block 63-64** — 2018 platform: revocation of mandate; desafuero for officials processed for corruption; "erradicar" corruption by example from Los Pinos.
- **Block 65** — Victory-night speech: punish "sea quien sea, será castigado. Incluyo a compañeros…". → **Campaign pledge, not evaluated outcome.**

### Distributional content — 5B.8
- **Block 48** — 2012 pledges: popular housing, universal education/health, targeted old-age pensions.
- **Block 62** — 2018: free internet nationwide; gender-equity labour measures; Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro scholarships; older-adult pensions. → **Pledges; no execution data in extract.**
- **Block 65** — "Por el bien de todos, primero los pobres" — **rhetorical framing**, not measured result.

### Macro criticism baked into biography
- **Block 58** — "200.000 personas habían sido asesinadas ya y varias miles más se encontraban desaparecidas o desplazadas" since 2006 → author-cited casualty figures attributed to general statistics (no methodology shown here).
- **Block 54** — AMLO December 2013 "infarto agudo de miocardio" requiring surgery → biographical, not 5B-economic.

## Limitations (must surface to next stage)
- Extract stops at 6/8/2018; **no 2022 policy execution, growth, inflation, debt, or distributional outcome data is present**. Treat any 5B answers leaning on this source for 2018-2022 as **unsupported** and refer to other dossier sources.
- Electoral returns are precisely stated (53.19% AMLO, 22.27% Anaya, 16.40% Meade, 5.23% Rodríguez Calderón); **turnout 64.4%** (block 65). Re-check these against PREP/TEPJF originals before quoting.
- Power-sector and energy-reform framings reflect competing partisan narratives (López Obrador vs. EPN/PRI); the biography does not adjudicate — flag as **contested interpretation**, not adjudicated fact.
- Claims about Calderon-era crime tolls, "guerra civil" framing, and "200,000 asesinados" need corroboration from UCDP/INEGI elsewhere.

## Sections a stronger model should reopen
- 2012 cabinet counter-factual (block 49).
- Quantitative impact of Calderón drug war (block 58).
- 2013 energy reform legal content (block 54): constitutional articles amended, contract modalities opened — not detailed here.
- MORENA electoral arc 2015-2017 (blocks 55-57) for 5B.9 context on pre-2018 fiscal/macro environment.

**No 5B scoring attempted.**
